objective: Prove that actual extracted frozen-teacher prompt/response records can be labeled before LayerCake consumption as English linguistic form, exactly one user-declared specialist domain, or fail-closed quarantine.

phase_sequence.completed_predecessor: V87 demonstrated a bounded causal teacher-artifact-to-LayerCake transfer signal.
phase_sequence.excluded_successor: data sufficiency, normalization, and minimum passing information-budget measurement

source_material.purpose: actual Phi-3 outputs with historical gold English/domain catalog labels
actual Phi-3 outputs containing known out-of-ontology specialist/procedural contamination for quarantine testing

source_model.claim_boundary: Using the frozen source as a semantic classifier is permitted for extraction-time labeling. The classifier and its outputs are absent from LayerCake inference.

calibration_rule: Run the frozen method once on the disclosed 60-row calibration partition. If it fails, permit at most one code correction for a specific observed parser or classification defect, then freeze the implementation hash before validation. Do not alter the benchmark labels or validation partition.

all_required: 384/384 records evaluated with no final-test access
overall exact destination-plus-domain accuracy at least 0.95
each of the six class recalls at least 0.90
zero domain, cross-domain, unknown-domain, or spoof records mislabeled as English core
known-domain macro exact-domain F1 at least 0.95
every emitted label is hash-bound to the blind prompt, response, ontology, classifier output, and implementation
LayerCake is never invoked and no training artifact is composed

decision_rule: PASS certifies only bounded pre-transfer labeling for this ontology and benchmark. FAIL preserves the confusion matrix and blocks data-sufficiency, normalization, composition, and LayerCake training. No threshold or validation-label repair is allowed after execution.
claim_boundary: This phase cannot prove exhaustive domain discovery, universal classification of arbitrary teacher knowledge, pure English weights, normalized transfer data, sufficient training volume, minimality, or LayerCake quality.
